title.original: Learning In Chaos: Efficient Autoscaling and Self-Healing for Multi-Party Distributed Training
title.zh: 乱序环境中的学习：面向多方分布式训练的高效自动扩缩容与自愈
title.en: Learning In Chaos: Efficient Autoscaling and Self-Healing for Multi-Party Distributed Training

inclusion_reason.zh: Chaos 提供去中心化状态复制、模型分片、拓扑监控和协商扩缩容，可复用于多机构 WAN 训练的自愈控制。
inclusion_reason.en: Chaos provides decentralized state replication, model sharding, topology monitoring, and negotiated autoscaling for reusable self-healing control in multi-party WAN training.

abstract.zh: Chaos 为跨机构、跨区域训练提供去中心化的自愈与自动扩缩容，通过邻居状态复制、模型分片和点对点协商应对节点与链路频繁变化。
abstract.en: Chaos provides decentralized self-healing and autoscaling for cross-institution training, using neighbor state replication, model sharding, and peer negotiation to handle node and link churn.

problem.zh: 多方 WAN 集群允许机构自主加入或退出，传统中心化扩缩容和检查点恢复反应慢，也不符合各方自主管理的控制边界。
problem.en: Multi-party WAN clusters allow institutions to join or leave autonomously, making centralized autoscaling and checkpoint recovery both slow and misaligned with governance boundaries.

approach.zh: 作者将异构 WAN 上的分片与分配形式化为优化问题，利用可除链的单调性化简并导出多项式贪心解，同时设计邻居复制和协商协议。
approach.en: The authors formulate sharding and assignment over heterogeneous WANs, exploit divisibility-chain monotonicity to derive a polynomial greedy solution, and pair it with neighbor replication and negotiation protocols.

system_design.zh: 集群监控器跟踪资源与拓扑，状态在多个邻居间复制；扩缩容事件触发各机构协商分片归属，并在无中央控制器的情况下恢复训练。
system_design.en: A cluster monitor tracks resources and topology, state is replicated across neighbors, and scaling events trigger peer negotiation over shard ownership so training recovers without a central controller.

key_results.zh: 在所测扩容、缩容和链路事件中，Chaos 比对照系统更快恢复并减少设备空闲，且集群扩大时仍保持较好的资源利用率。
key_results.en: Across the evaluated scale and link events, Chaos recovers faster than comparison systems, reduces idle time, and maintains stronger resource utilization as the cluster grows.

limitations.zh: 设计主要处理非恶意 churn，未说明拜占庭参与方和隐私攻击；多副本开销、极窄 WAN 链路及超大优化器状态可能限制扩展性。
limitations.en: The design primarily addresses benign churn rather than Byzantine parties or privacy attacks; replica overhead, narrow WAN links, and very large optimizer state may constrain scale.

notes.zh: 已填模型、工作负载、硬件、基线和指标均来自官方 arXiv 摘要或 comment；摘要未披露的表格明细、硬件拓扑与集群配置仍待全文审计。
notes.en: Populated models, workloads, hardware, baselines, and metrics come from the official arXiv abstract or comment; undisclosed table details, hardware topology, and cluster configuration still require full-text audit.
